source: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Official USDA Thrifty Food Plan: U.S. Average
basis: USDA's monthly cost of a nutritious, low-cost diet with all meals prepared at home, for a reference family of four (two adults 20-50, children 6-8 and 9-11). National reference line only: not a metro value and not part of the grocery basket.
attribution: Source: USDA, Thrifty Food Plan cost of food report

usda_tfp_reference_family.description: USDA Thrifty Food Plan, U.S. average monthly cost for the reference family of four (male and female 20-50, children 6-8 and 9-11), as published
